findings.title: More than 43,000 life-changing injuries reported in Gaza; rehabilitation service capacity reduced 62%
findings.source_title: أكثر من 43 ألف إصابة مغيرة للحياة في غزة جراء عدوان الاحتلال المستمر
findings.affected_population_system: People with severe traumatic injuries, rehabilitation and neurorehabilitation services, including children and young adults
findings.finding_summary: Al-Quds quotes Gaza Health Ministry deputy Maher Shamiya at a neurorehabilitation scientific event reporting more than 43,000 life-changing injuries accumulated since October 2023 (about one quarter of reported injuries), approximately 1,800 traumatic brain injuries and 2,000 spinal-cord injuries, and a reported 62% reduction in rehabilitation services. These are newly reported cumulative estimates and service-capacity claims, not 43,000 new injuries during this hourly window. No independent primary-source transcript located in the bounded check.
